# The Python API {#sec-pyapi}

Every public class, function and method of the package `biyos`, generated from its docstrings and its annotations. The package ships its annotations, so an editor or a type checker reads the same types. [The Python package](#sec-python) describes the package as a whole, and [The C API](#sec-capi) gives the rules each method follows.
